description: Check any Solana token (SPL or Token-2022) for red flags, read from public on-chain data: whether more tokens can be minted, whether holders can be frozen, Token-2022 tricks (transfer fees, permanent delegate, transfer hooks), copycat names of well-known tokens, mutable metadata and holder concentration. Returns findings with a level (bad, warn, ok) and plain-words explanations. No red flags never means a token is safe; this is not financial advice.

address.description: The token's mint (contract) address, base58, 32 to 44 characters

name: check_token
title: Solana Token Safety Check
